answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 43137 Country: India Title: Hadith Question: I came to know that we Hanafi accept weak Hadith as well, in deriving our fatwa. So, what is the need for segregation of Hadith as Sahih, Hasan, Zaeef, etc? Please respond to my question. I would be highly obliged. Answer ID: 43137 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 98/79/N=1434) If Sahih or Hasan hadith is available then no Imam accepts week hadith in any case. But if no Sahih or Hasan hadith is available or it is not clear on the ruling then in proving the ruling or fixing a meaning the week hadith is accepted by all the Imams and it is given preference on Qiyas, not only Ahnaf. For details see the booklet “Hadith Zaeef Ki Istidlali Haysiyat” by Hadhrat Mufti Abdullah Maroofi, Ustad Takhassus Fil Hadith, Darul Uloom Deoband. This booklet is available on the website of Darul Uloom as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
